drum_performances.name: Uriel Jones
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Stevie Wonder's first record as his own producer, one of the last Hitsville hits before Motown left Detroit.

evidence.note: Drummerszone's obituary and his Find a Grave memorial name him; Wikipedia names no drummer.

drums.description: Eighths on the hat, the kick on 1, the "a" of 2 and 3, and the Motown pickup on the snare into almost every second bar; a bar of sixteenths on the snare before the last verse. At 109.

evidence.note: Drummerszone's obituary and his Find a Grave memorial name him; Wikipedia names no drummer.

transcriptions.note: Human tab at 107; the record is 109
